title: Seismic reinforcement in Seismic Design Category D.
officialText:
Where a structure is assigned to Seismic
Design Category D in accordance with Section 1613, the requirements of Seismic Design Category C shall apply,
except that transverse reinforcement shall comply with requirements of Section 1810.1.2.5.
